verdict.rationale: Exa's core interfaces take natural language directly. Search is documented as "search the web in natural language," Websets start from a natural-language query with criteria and enrichments, `answer()` and Exa Agent accept plain questions and research tasks, and an official MCP server lets ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and other assistants drive these tools conversationally. Hands-on community reports show uneven results from natural-language Websets and searches: missing enrichment columns, verification stuck for minutes, and roughly 30/70 hit rate on repo search. missing for 10: evidence that account/configuration management can be done via natural language (not just search/research tasks), and independent corroboration that natural-language commands reliably produce correct results.
